comments.author: gens
comments.story: Ask HN: What are you working on?
comments.why: Ubisoft talk matching the commenter's own engine design
comments.text: I'm making a game/engine with efficiency/performance as a top goal. I'v spent years thinking about the design. And after i figured it out, i found a talk from an Ubisoft employee that is mostly what i came up with. The problems are many, especially since i want to support multiplayer. The biggest solutions are around how data is transformed and scheduling the code that transforms it, more or less. The talk: [VIDEO]

comments.why: Ubisoft talk going deep on atomic ops, compared with Naughty Dog's
comments.text: Similar talk: CppCon 2014: Jeff Preshing "How Ubisoft Develops Games for Multicore - Before and After C++11" [VIDEO] Ubisoft's talk spends more time getting into the weeds with atomic ops. Naughty Dog's is more of an architecture discussion. If you can only watch one, I'll recommend Naughty Dog's.
